32518	def _load_toml_file(path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
32519	    """Use stdlib tomllib (3.11+), fall back to tomli, then a tiny parser."""
32520	    if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):
32521	        import tomllib
32522	        with path.open("rb") as f:
32523	            return tomllib.load(f)
32524	    try:
32525	        import tomli
32526	        with path.open("rb") as f:
32527	            return tomli.load(f)
32528	    except ImportError:
32529	        data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
32530	        section = None
32531	        for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
32532	            line = line.split("#", 1)[0].rstrip()
32533	            if not line:
32534	                continue
32535	            m = _re_consolidated.match(r"\[([\w.]+)\]", line)
32536	            if m:
32537	                section = m.group(1)
32538	                cur = data
32539	                for part in section.split("."):
32540	                    cur = cur.setdefault(part, {})
32541	                continue
32542	            m = _re_consolidated.match(r"(\w+)\s*=\s*(.+)", line)
32543	            if m and section is not None:
32544	                key, raw = m.group(1), m.group(2).strip()
32545	                cur = data
32546	                for part in section.split("."):
32547	                    cur = cur.setdefault(part, {})
32548	                try:
32549	                    v = eval(raw, {"__builtins__": {}},
32550	                             {"true": True, "false": False})
32551	                except Exception as _swexc:
32552	                    _debug_swallow('_load_toml_file', _swexc)
32553	                    v = raw.strip('"').strip("'")
32554	                cur[key] = v
32555	        return data

32559	    """Merge in priority order: caller path > CWD compile_config.toml > inlined defaults."""
32560	    layers: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [_DEFAULT_PROJECT_CONFIG]
32561	    cwd_path = Path.cwd() / CWD_CONFIG_NAME
32562	    if cwd_path.exists():

32566	            # Shouldn't fire — we just checked .exists() — but defensive.

32571	                f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}; continuing with built-in "

32581	def _deep_merge(*dicts: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
32582	    out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
32583	    for d in dicts:
32584	        for k, v in d.items():
32585	            if (k in out and isinstance(out[k], dict)
32586	                    and isinstance(v, dict)):
32587	                out[k] = _deep_merge(out[k], v)
32588	            else:
32589	                # deepcopy so a nested dict/list present in only ONE layer
32590	                # (e.g. _DEFAULT_PROJECT_CONFIG) is not aliased into the result
32591	                # — a caller mutating the returned config's nested values must
32592	                # not corrupt the module-global default for the rest of the run.
32593	                out[k] = copy.deepcopy(v)
32594	    return out
